column3: “Go forth” renders “go for yourself,” and “country” renders “land.”
“And so you shall be a blessing” renders the imperative “and be a blessing.”
“curses” renders two different Hebrew verbs (“treats lightly” and “curses”), and “shall be blessed” may also mean “shall bless themselves.”
“the site” renders “the place,” and “the oak(s)” renders a word that may mean “terebinth” or “great tree.”
“continuing toward the Negev” renders “going and journeying toward the Negev (south).”
“that I may live” renders “that my soul may live.”
